cards.title: ALSP Market Hits $26.6B — Asia-Pacific Fastest at 11.1% CAGR
cards.body: Global ALSP market reached $26.6 billion in 2025, forecast to hit $61.4B by 2035 at 8.72% CAGR. Asia Pacific is the fastest-growing region at 11.1% CAGR. Corporate legal departments are the fastest-growing segment (9.57% CAGR). Independent ALSPs hold 79% share.

cards.title: India: 183 GCCs in H1 2026, 5.1 Lakh Jobs
cards.body: India added 183 GCC units in H1 2026. GCC hiring reached 5.1 lakh (510,000) jobs — a new peak. thyssenkrupp (Pune, Oct 9), Anaplan (Gurugram), Orbia (Pune) among latest. US companies account for 57% of new entries. Fractional GC pipeline at record levels.

cards.title: US: In-House Legal Tech Spend $1,400/Lawyer/Year
cards.body: Median in-house legal tech spend: $1,400 per lawyer/year. Mid-market budgets rose 18% YoY. 61% deployed or piloting GenAI (up from 29% two years ago). Enterprise AI licensing: $50K-$500K annually. 73% of CLOC respondents say legal ops controls tech purchasing.

cards.title: UK: 96% AI Integration, 65% ALSP Adoption
cards.body: 96% of UK firms integrated AI, 62% planning to expand. 34% investing £100K+ in technology. 54% shifted to fixed-fee billing. UK leads globally with 65% ALSP adoption. FCA crypto regime + Digital Security & AI Bill adding compliance demand.

cards.title: 86% GCs vs 17% C-Suite Visibility Gap
cards.body: 86% of GCs believe legal contributes to business strategy, but only 17% of C-Suite agrees. 42% of C-Suite says legal contributes “little or not at all.” TC bridges this gap with data-driven reporting and fractional GC services.

cards.title: DPDP Consent Manager Deadline — 33 Days
cards.body: DPDP Act Consent Manager Framework (Rule 4) goes live Nov 13. DPBI appointments still pending but penalties codified at INR 50Cr. TC positions as compliance-readiness partner for enterprises preparing despite regulatory uncertainty.

cards.title: 69% of Legal Professionals Now Use AI Tools
cards.body: 69% of legal professionals now use AI tools — more than doubled from prior year. Corporate legal AI adoption rose from 23% (2024) to 54% (2025). 90% of GCs say resource limitations prevent strategic impact. AI adoption gap = outsourcing demand.

cards.title: Fractional GC — 183 GCC Pipeline
cards.body: 183 GCCs in H1 2026. Latest: thyssenkrupp (Pune), Anaplan (Gurugram), Orbia (Pune), UBS (3,000+ hires), DAZN (INR 500Cr). Most lack dedicated India legal teams. Pitch: Full-stack India legal ops at a fraction of an in-house hire.

cards.title: DPDP Compliance-as-a-Service
cards.body: 33-day window to sell DPDP readiness packages. Penalties: INR 50Cr (consent manager), INR 250Cr (full compliance). Package: consent manager assessment + privacy policy audit + employee training. Target: Series B+ startups, GCCs, mid-market enterprises.

competitors_summary: Three HIGH-threat competitors active: SpotDraft ($92M, on-device AI, Qualcomm backing), Legistify (350+ enterprise clients, CFO buyers), and Harvey AI ($15.5B, 80% AmLaw 100).
